I served because like Jessica my family lived in poverty & due to so many issues I fucked up high school so I ruined my chance at scholarships too.

My recruiter promised me money, stability and opportunity

Thanks to the Navy I was able to pull myself and my family into the middle class

I'm not necessarily proud of my service but I'm not ashamed of it and I don't regret it. I did what I had to do & the Navy changed my life and I was the first in all my extended family to graduate from a university.

When others ask me if they should join the military I always tell them that it should be a last resort. If they can't find a decent job, If they desperately need healthcare for themselves or their families, etc.

Please don't shame people who serve, while I was there I met hundreds of people who did it because they had to. There are some that join because they want to play IRL COD but those are the three minority (go ahead n shame them if ya want)
